title: Two-step rally
description: Price climbs from 65,233 to a 71,072 high (25 Mar 19:00) in two upswings. The 67,205 high (24 Mar 23:00) pulls back to 66,555 and is closed above at 03:00 (67,352); the 67,507 high (25 Mar 04:00) pulls back to 66,828 and is closed above at 13:00 (68,029). The run on to 71,072 is not a swing: no pullback from it has been broken yet.
